title: The hypercube maximum-density conjecture for monochromatic k-in-a-row
statement:
Let $[k]^d$ be the $d$-dimensional grid, with $k\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}$ and $d\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $D(k,[k]^d)$ denote the maximum density of a configuration avoiding the relevant $k$-in-a-row patterns. **Hypercube density conjecture.** For every $k\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}$ and $d\in\mathbb{N}$,

$$
D(k,[k]^d)=1-\frac{2}{k}.
$$

The source motivates this by a construction attaining the value when $k/2$ is a natural number coprime with $d!$; the assertion for all $k$ and $d$ remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12880

Status: **open** according to the source (as of June 2026). “For small values of $k$, the conjecture has been verified in several cases , while it remains open in general.”
source_name: Kuo-Han Ku, “Monochromatic k in a row”, arXiv:2606.12880 (2026).
